opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search (outbound/return) and fare selection
opportunities.description: Search Ryanair for a one-way or round-trip flight by setting origin airport, destination airport, depart and return dates, and passenger counts, then search and pick the outbound and return flights.
steps: Click the From field, type the origin city, and pick the airport from the Pick-an-airport list (for example Dublin).
Click the To field, choose the destination country from the list if needed, then pick the destination airport (for example Athens, Malta, Paris Beauvais, Venice Treviso).
Open the date picker, click the depart date, and if needed navigate months with the arrow or the month chips before clicking the day.
For round trips, click the return date in the same calendar.
Open the Passengers panel, click + for Adults (or other types), and click Done.
Click Search.
On the results page, click Select on the chosen outbound flight, then click Select on the chosen return flight.
parameters: number of adults (and optionally teens, children, infants)

instances.values: Dublin to Athens, depart 2 Apr 2023, return 5 Apr 2023, 1 adult. Outbound and return selected on results (02 Apr 05:55 flight, 05 Apr 20:45 flight).
Dublin to Malta, depart 22 Apr 2023 (one-way view), 2 adults. Search clicked at 517.5; no result selection in trace.
To Paris Beauvais, depart 26 Apr 2023, return 2 May 2023, passengers raised to 2 adults, promo code typed as 1000001. The From field was first typed as Tel Aviv and changed to Dublin during the flow.

Tel Aviv to Venice Treviso, depart 9 May 2023, return 16 May 2023, 1 adult. Outbound (09 May 18:20) and return (16 May 13:00) selected on results. The earlier From-field change is not in the trace, so the origin is inferred from the screen.

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant search by cuisine or name and open a result
opportunities.description: On Resy, set the city, type a cuisine or restaurant name into the search box, and open the matching restaurant from the dropdown.
steps: Optionally click the city selector and choose the target city.
Click the Search restaurants, cuisines, etc. box and type the query.
In the dropdown, click the matching restaurant (or the cuisine tag).
Confirm the restaurant page has loaded.

instances.values: Columbus, OH; query "thai"; opened Senyai Thai Kitchen (Shadyside, Pittsburgh).
Miami location; query "high tide"; opened High Tide (Dumbo, Brooklyn).
Sydney location; query "pasta"; opened the Pasta Emilia result from the results page.

opportunities.name: Resy: set a notify request for a fully booked meal slot
opportunities.description: On a Resy restaurant page, pick the date and party size, click Notify on a meal section, set the preferred time window, and confirm to be alerted when a table opens.
steps: Open the restaurant page.
Set the date in the date picker (for example Fri Apr 21 then change to Mon Apr 17).
Set the Guests dropdown to the party size.
Click the Notify button for the meal (Dinner or Lunch).
In the Set Notify dialog, choose the preferred start time and end time.
Click Confirm.

instances.values: Senyai Thai Kitchen, Thu Apr 6 2023, 2 guests, Dinner, window 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.
High Tide, date changed from Fri Apr 21 to Mon Apr 17 2023, 2 guests, Notify for Lunch clicked (no time dialog in trace).

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search by destination and date, then open a ticket
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Attractions, pick a destination (typed or from the region grid) and a visit date, search, and open a tour or attraction to check availability and tickets.
steps: Click the Attractions tab on the Booking.com home page.
Enter the destination in the Where are you going? box and pick the suggestion, or open a region tile (for example Asia) and click the city tile.
Click Select your dates and click the target day in the calendar.
Click Search.
Open the top relevant result (for example by clicking its title or See availability).
On the tour page, open the date picker, select the date, and pick the ticket counts and Next.
parameters: optional filters such as Free cancellation, Tours category, Most popular sort

instances.values: Attraction "Aquarium of Paris" typed and picked from suggestions; date 5 May 2023; Search; opened the Aquarium of Paris heading and gallery.

Attractions tab, then region Asia, then city Kyoto (40 things to do); date 25 May 2023; filters Free cancellation and Tours; sort Most popular; opened Fushimi Inari Shrine Hiking Tour and set 2 adults, 1 infant, then Next.
